name: Financial Hardship
overview: Scripture acknowledges that believers will face financial hardship and various trials, yet it calls them to trust in God's sovereign will and provision. Though Jesus Himself prayed for relief from suffering, He ultimately submitted to the Father's plan, teaching us to do likewise (Luke 22:42). God promises to supply all our needs according to His glorious riches (Philippians 4:19), and He assures us that His thoughts toward us are for peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11). Even in the midst of tribulation, believers are encouraged to find joy and peace in Christ, who has overcome the world (John 16:33; James 1:2).
